app.name: Ishi
app.tagline: A patient Go teacher, at your level.

home.captureStreak: Wins in a row: {streak} of 3 to move up
home.examReady: You're ready! Win 3 capture games before losing 3.
home.examLocked: Finish all 10 lessons and play 5 capture games to unlock the exam.
home.fullInfo: Real rules: surround the most area. Komi 7.
home.fullLocked: Opens after you earn the Yellow belt.
home.lessonReady: Your teacher picked one moment from your last game.
home.gymDue: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing due — practise a few new puzzles.} one {1 puzzle to review today.} other {# puzzles to review today.}}
home.todayWarmup: {n, plural, =0 {Warm-up done} one {Warm up: 1 puzzle} other {Warm up: # puzzles}}
home.examReadyBelt: You're ready! 12 puzzles first (10 to pass), then win 2 of 3 games.
home.examLockedBelt: Keep playing 9×9 games: the exam opens when your level is close to the next belt.

health.title: System status
health.unreachable: Can't reach the app server. Is it running on your PC?

errors.bad_coordinate: That point isn't on the board.
errors.invalid_request: Something went wrong with that request.

reason.suicide: That stone would have no liberties (suicide isn't allowed).
reason.ko: Ko: you can't take back right away. Play somewhere else first.
reason.off_board: That point isn't on the board.

errors.no_nudge: There's no teacher question to give a hint for.
errors.exam_not_ready: Finish the exam puzzles before the games.
errors.exam_puzzle_done: That exam puzzle is already answered.

sandbox.title: Practice board
sandbox.subtitle: Two players, one device. Tap once to place a ghost stone, tap again to play.
sandbox.areaNote: Area count: stones + surrounded empty points, komi {komi}. Dead stones are not removed here.

school.title: Rules school
school.locked: This lesson is locked. Finish the earlier lessons first.

feedback.keep_going: Good — the opponent answered. Keep going.
feedback.not_capture: That doesn't capture. Look for stones with only one liberty.
feedback.not_atari: Not atari yet. Leave the stones with exactly one liberty.
feedback.not_escaped: Still in danger. Your stones need at least two liberties.
feedback.not_connected: Not connected yet. Stones connect along the lines, not diagonally.
feedback.not_cut: That doesn't cut them apart. Play where both stones touch.
feedback.not_pass: Not a stone this time. Look at the buttons under the board.
feedback.not_two_eyes: Not two eyes yet. Try another point.
feedback.not_there: Not that point. Read the task again.
feedback.place_stone: Place a stone on the board.
feedback.wrong_count: Not quite. Count again — the circles show what to count.
feedback.incomplete: Good start — there are more to find.
feedback.wrong_choice: Not quite. Count both sides again.

illegal.suicide: You can't play there: that stone would have no liberties.
illegal.ko: Ko: you can't take back right away.
illegal.off_board: That point isn't on the board.

play.title: Capture Go
play.fullHint: When nothing useful is left, press Pass. The game ends when both players pass in a row.
play.deadNote: Stones with a cross were counted as dead.

exam.title: {belt} exam
exam.failed: Not this time. Play 3 more 9×9 games, then try again.
exam.rulesYellow: Play capture Go on 9×9: first to capture 3. Win 3 games before you lose 3.
exam.rulesPuzzles: {total} puzzles. One try each, no hints. Solve {needed} to go on.
exam.rulesGames: Then 9×9 games against a {bot} bot: win 2 before you lose 2.
exam.rulesNoHelp: Your teacher stays quiet in exam games: no questions before moves.
exam.puzzleMissed: Not this one. Here is the answer.
exam.failedYellow: Not this time. Play 3 more capture games, then try again.
exam.failedPuzzles: Not enough puzzles solved this time. Play 3 more 9×9 games, then try again.

lesson.title: Lesson
lesson.preparing: Your teacher is looking at the game…
lesson.unavailable: The teacher is resting (engine offline). Start the engine and come back.
lesson.faded: The faded stone with a cross is the move you played.
lesson.playPrompt: Play your answer on the board.

retry.solution: Here is the move, and how it continues.

gym.title: Shape Gym

task.missed_capture: Capture the stones you can take.
task.ignored_atari: Your stones are in atari. Save them.
task.self_atari: Make your stones safe, without walking into atari.
task.ladder: Catch the stones that are trying to run.

hint.missed_capture: Count the liberties of the marked stones.
hint.ignored_atari: The marked stones have one liberty left. Can they get more?
hint.self_atari: Before you play, count the liberties your stones will have.
hint.ladder: Chase the marked stones toward the edge or your own stones.
hint.cut_disconnect: Where could the opponent cut your stones apart?
hint.group_death: Your marked group needs two eyes. Find the key point inside.

gym.nextDue: {days, plural, one {You'll see this again tomorrow.} other {You'll see this again in # days.}}
gym.empty: No puzzles right now. Come back tomorrow.

progress.title: Progress
progress.noRankNote: Play a few 9×9 games and Ishi will estimate your level.
progress.rankNote: Your estimated level, from how you play and your results ({games, plural, one {1 game} other {# games}}).
progress.chartEmpty: Your chart starts after your first 9×9 game.
progress.examReady: The {belt} exam is open: start it from the home screen.
progress.examNeeds: {belt} exam: reach about {rank} and play {games, plural, =0 {— games done} one {1 more game} other {# more games}}.
progress.conceptsEmpty: Nothing yet: your mistakes show up here after 9×9 games.
progress.examNeedsGames: {belt} exam: your level is close enough — play {games, plural, =0 {— games done} one {1 more game} other {# more games}}.
